zh.headline: Meta 收购 Conductor，OpenAI 补齐 Git 基础设施
headline_alt: 编码 Agent 成为大厂并购主线
美国中期选举给数据中心扩张踩下刹车
zh.observation: 今天最清晰的信号是编码 agent 的基础设施化：Meta 收购 Conductor、OpenAI 收购 Pierre 并自建 Git 后端 Pando，竞争焦点已从“模型能不能写代码”转向“多 agent 如何并行协作、版本如何管理”。与此同时，Uber 单季仅 4 单 agent 代订与 CloudOpsBench 指出的推理瓶颈，提醒 agent 的真实渗透率远低于叙事热度。研究侧，“长度不是问题、竞争才是”和“不需要长上下文”两篇论文指向同一结论：上下文工程的关键在于去干扰与主动压缩。政治层面，美国中期选举否决数据中心、Google 以搜索捆绑 AI 施压学校，则说明 AI 扩张正遭遇来自地方政治与平台监管的双重摩擦。

items.title: Meta 收购 AI 编码初创 Conductor
items.desc: Conductor 允许工程师部署多个 agent 并行处理项目的不同部分，Meta 将其收入囊中补强编码 agent 能力。
items.value: 多 agent 并行编码成为大厂必争之地，工具链整合加速。

items.title: OpenAI 收购 Pierre Computer Company
items.desc: Pierre 的库已支撑 Codex，结合此前发布的 Git 后端 Pando，OpenAI 正为“人机协同写代码”重建开发者基础设施。
items.value: Git/版本控制层成为 agent 编码的下一个基础设施战场。

items.title: Ricursive 发布 Ripple-65B Preview
items.desc: 65B 稠密开源权重模型（Apache 2.0），Terminal-Bench 2.1 得分 80.5，领先美国同类开源模型最高 15 倍参数量级。
items.value: 小体量稠密模型在 agentic coding 上刷新美国开源 SOTA。

items.title: OpenAI 发布 Images 2.6
items.desc: 更快的图像生成、原生 GIF 创建（可调速度、逐帧编辑）、更精确编辑，并新增 API 控制项，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 与 API。
items.value: GIF 逐帧一致性提升，为动图/分镜类产品打开 API 能力。

items.title: Anthropic 推出 FlashProve 可验证推理原型
items.desc: 用密码学方法证明某条 AI 回复确实出自声称的模型，且不暴露权重，但仍有明显局限。
items.value: 模型溯源与合规审计的新路径，API 供应商值得关注。

items.title: OpenAI 自动化流水线挖出 948 个 Linux 内核提权漏洞
items.desc: 自主完成发现、验证并生成补丁，是 agent 用于安全研究的规模化案例。
items.value: agent 在漏洞挖掘与补丁生成上已可规模化落地。

items.title: 美国中期选举：选民否决数据中心，AI PAC 投入未奏效
items.desc: 多地选出支持暂停令的候选人，76% 受访选民对数据中心持负面态度；硅谷支持的 1 亿美元 pro-AI Super PAC 网络影响有限。
items.value: AI 基建扩张的政治阻力上升，选址与审批成本将走高。

items.title: Uber：上季度仅 4 单由 AI agent 完成
items.desc: Uber Eats 侧约 500 单，agent 代订出行几乎为零。
items.value: 给“agent 取代 App”的叙事泼冷水，真实采用率极低。

items.title: 后摩智能完成数十亿元 B 轮融资
items.desc: 存算一体芯片赛道获资本密集加注。
items.value: 非冯·诺依曼架构在推理能效上的路线获产业资本背书。

items.title: Google 2027 年起对关停 AI 的学校一并关闭搜索
items.desc: AI Overviews 与传统搜索深度耦合，学校“选择权”名存实亡，引发教育界与政界反弹。
items.value: 平台捆绑策略的监管风险样本，教育市场或现替代窗口。

items.title: MIT：GPT-6 Astra 可直接读写其他模型权重
items.desc: 无需传统训练，仅改动 Qwen 模型 0.016% 的权重，就把数学准确率从 7.9% 提升到 48.1%。
items.value: 模型间“权重级编辑”或大幅简化优化流程，但边界尚存。

items.title: “You don't need long context”
items.desc: 前沿开源模型后段 token 生成成本可达前段 7 倍；通过频繁压缩维持短上下文，长程任务精度几乎无损。
items.value: 上下文管理策略比堆窗口更划算，直接影响推理成本设计。

items.title: “Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not”
items.desc: 长输入失败主因不是长度而是干扰——中性填充下 32K 仍保持 0.97+ 准确率，同格式竞争性陈述可令其跌至 0.16。
items.value: RAG 与长文档检索应优先去重去干扰，而非截断长度。

items.title: Dory1.0-4B：循环式 nGPT 支持弹性深度
items.desc: 单一 checkpoint 可按推理预算调整循环块次数，6 万亿 token 预训练。
items.value: 一份权重适配多档算力，端侧与云端部署可复用。

items.title: CloudOpsBench：推理是云运维 agent 最大瓶颈
items.desc: 开源基准覆盖修服务、撤资源、限权限、灰度发布等典型 DevOps 任务。
items.value: 为运维 agent 提供可复现评测，暴露推理短板。

items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology（日增 2,050 star）
items.desc: 在数据之上构建语义图推理层的 Python 框架，支持确定性查询生成与更可解释的 agent 上下文检索。
items.value: 给 agent 加“结构化知识层”，降低幻觉、提升可解释性。

items.title: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c（日增 351 star）
items.desc: 2.78 万亿参数 Kimi K3 在单 CPU、8.24 GB 内存上推理，纯 C99，无 BLAS、无框架、无 GPU。
items.value: 极限量化/稀疏推理的工程示范，端侧大模型想象空间。

items.title: Vercel Labs 开源 fx：面向嵌入式的 Zig 编程 agent
items.desc: 专为嵌入式应用设计。
items.value: 编码 agent 向嵌入式/裸机场景延伸。

items.title: Tencent WeVisOne-VL（Apache 2.0）
items.desc: 2B/4B 视觉语言模型，单模型统一检测、OCR、计数、分割与 alpha matting。
items.value: 小而全的视觉底座，适合文档/图像处理流水线。

items.title: DeepSeek 单日占 OpenRouter 53% token，开源权重实验室合计超 75%
items.desc: r/LocalLLaMA 引用 dirac.run 数据（当日 27 万亿 token），引发对“开源模型是否已在真实流量上反超闭源”的讨论。
items.value: 推理侧开源份额数据，是评估模型选型与成本的风向标。

items.title: Hugging Face CEO Delangue：我的 P(Doom) “接近于零”
items.desc: 他称“大部分风险其实来自少数几个闭门造车的玩家”，为开源路线辩护，与主流 AI 安全叙事形成鲜明对立。
items.value: 开源 vs 闭源的安全话语权之争，影响监管走向。

en.headline: Meta acquires Conductor, OpenAI fills out Git infrastructure
headline_alt: Coding agents become the main line of big-tech M&A
US midterms put the brakes on data center expansion
en.observation: The clearest signal today is the infrastructuralization of coding agents: Meta acquired Conductor, OpenAI acquired Pierre and built its own Git backend Pando, and the competitive focus has shifted from "can the model write code" to "how do multiple agents collaborate in parallel and how is versioning managed." Meanwhile, Uber's mere 4 agent-booked rides in a quarter and the inference bottlenecks flagged by CloudOpsBench remind us that agents' real penetration is far below the narrative hype. On the research side, two papers—"length is not the problem, competition is" and "no need for long context"—point to the same conclusion: the key to context engineering lies in removing distractions and active compression. On the political front, US midterm elections rejecting data centers and Google pressuring schools by bundling AI with search show that AI expansion is running into dual friction from local politics and platform regulation.

items.title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
items.desc: Conductor lets engineers deploy multiple agents to work on different parts of a project in parallel, and Meta has acquired it to strengthen its coding agent capabilities.
items.value: Multi-agent parallel coding becomes a battleground for big tech, accelerating toolchain consolidation.

items.title: OpenAI acquires Pierre Computer Company
items.desc: Pierre's libraries already power Codex, and combined with the previously released Git backend Pando, OpenAI is rebuilding developer infrastructure for "humans and machines writing code together."
items.value: The Git/version-control layer becomes the next infrastructure battleground for agentic coding.

items.title: Ricursive releases Ripple-65B Preview
items.desc: A 65B dense open-weight model (Apache 2.0) scoring 80.5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1, leading comparable US open-source models by up to 15x in parameter scale.
items.value: A small dense model sets a new US open-source SOTA in agentic coding.

items.title: OpenAI releases Images 2.6
items.desc: Faster image generation, native GIF creation (adjustable speed, frame-by-frame editing), more precise editing, and new API controls, across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.
items.value: Better GIF frame consistency opens API capabilities for animated/storyboard products.

items.title: Anthropic launches FlashProve verifiable inference prototype
items.desc: Uses cryptography to prove a given AI response genuinely came from the claimed model without exposing weights, though notable limitations remain.
items.value: A new path for model provenance and compliance auditing; worth watching for API providers.

items.title: OpenAI automated pipeline uncovers 948 Linux kernel privilege-escalation vulnerabilities
items.desc: Autonomously discovers, verifies, and generates patches—a large-scale case of agents used in security research.
items.value: Agents can now scale vulnerability discovery and patch generation in practice.

items.title: US midterms: voters reject data centers, AI PAC spending falls flat
items.desc: Many districts elected candidates backing moratoriums, 76% of surveyed voters view data centers negatively, and Silicon Valley-backed $100M pro-AI Super PAC networks had limited impact.
items.value: Rising political resistance to AI infrastructure will raise siting and approval costs.

items.title: Uber: only 4 rides last quarter were completed by AI agents
items.desc: About 500 orders on the Uber Eats side, with agent-booked rides near zero.
items.value: A reality check on the "agents replace apps" narrative—real adoption is minimal.

items.title: Houmo AI closes multi-billion-yuan Series B
items.desc: The compute-in-memory chip sector draws intensive capital.
items.value: Non-von Neumann architectures gain industry capital backing for inference energy efficiency.

items.title: Google to shut off Search for schools that disable AI starting 2027
items.desc: AI Overviews are deeply coupled with traditional search, making schools' "choice" nominal and sparking backlash from educators and politicians.
items.value: A regulatory-risk case study in platform bundling; an opening for alternatives in education.

items.title: MIT: GPT-6 Astra can directly read and write other models' weights
items.desc: Without conventional training, it modified just 0.016% of the Qwen model's weights to raise math accuracy from 7.9% to 48.1%.
items.value: "Weight-level editing" between models could greatly simplify optimization, but limits remain.

items.title: "You don't need long context"
items.desc: In frontier open-source models, generating later tokens can cost up to 7x more than early tokens; frequent compression to keep context short preserves long-horizon task accuracy almost losslessly.
items.value: Context management beats piling on window size, directly shaping inference cost design.

items.title: "Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not"
items.desc: Long-input failures stem mainly from distraction, not length—with neutral filler, accuracy stays at 0.97+ at 32K, but same-format competing statements can drop it to 0.16.
items.value: RAG and long-document retrieval should prioritize deduplication and distraction removal over truncation.

items.title: Dory1.0-4B: Recurrent nGPT supports elastic depth
items.desc: A single checkpoint can adjust the number of recurrent blocks based on inference budget, pretrained on 6 trillion tokens.
items.value: One set of weights fits multiple compute tiers, reusable for edge and cloud deployment.

items.title: CloudOpsBench: Reasoning is the biggest bottleneck for cloud ops agents
items.desc: An open-source benchmark covering typical DevOps tasks such as fixing services, deprovisioning resources, restricting permissions, and canary releases.
items.value: Provides reproducible evaluation for ops agents, exposing reasoning weaknesses.

items.title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology (+2,050 stars/day)
items.desc: A Python framework that builds a semantic graph reasoning layer on top of data, supporting deterministic query generation and more interpretable agent context retrieval.
items.value: Adds a "structured knowledge layer" to agents, reducing hallucinations and improving interpretability.

items.title: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c (+351 stars/day)
items.desc: Runs inference on the 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 on a single CPU with 8.24 GB of memory, in pure C99, with no BLAS, no framework, and no GPU.
items.value: An engineering showcase for extreme quantization/sparse inference, expanding the possibilities for on-device large models.

items.title: Vercel Labs open-sources fx: a Zig coding agent for embedded systems
items.desc: Designed specifically for embedded applications.
items.value: Extends coding agents into embedded/bare-metal scenarios.

items.title: Tencent WeVisOne-VL (Apache 2.0)
items.desc: A 2B/4B vision-language model that unifies detection, OCR, counting, segmentation, and alpha matting in a single model.
items.value: A small yet comprehensive vision foundation, suited for document/image processing pipelines.

items.title: DeepSeek alone accounts for 53% of OpenRouter tokens in a single day; open-weight labs combined exceed 75%
items.desc: r/LocalLLaMA cites dirac.run data (27 trillion tokens that day), sparking discussion on whether "open models have already overtaken closed models in real traffic."
items.value: Inference-side open-source share data is a bellwether for model selection and cost.

items.title: Hugging Face CEO Delangue: My P(Doom) is "close to zero"
items.desc: He says "most of the risk actually comes from a handful of closed-door players," defending the open-source path in sharp contrast to the mainstream AI safety narrative.
items.value: The open vs. closed safety discourse shapes regulatory direction.
